Expressions.Grammar: numbers; + - * / (real); ( ); < <= > >= == != ; c ? a : b ; floor ceil trunc round min max abs sqrt clamp(x,lo,hi) rand(lo,hi) (integer, inclusive) randf() ([0,1))
Expressions.Variables: Caster.<X> / Target.<X>: skill value (Magery, EvalInt, MagicResist, Inscribe, Poisoning, Meditation, Focus, DetectHidden, Hiding, Stealth) or <Skill>Fixed (integer tenths); Str Dex Int RawStr RawDex RawInt Hits HitsMax Stam StamMax Mana ManaMax IsPlayer PoisonLevel. Distance (straight-line tiles), Range (max(|dx|,|dy|)), Count (targets hit). Other names are defined next to the formula that uses them.
Expressions.Trunc: trunc() reproduces C# integer casts and integer division (toward zero).

Pools.Source: Server/Mobile.cs, Scripts/Mobiles/PlayerMobile.cs, Scripts/Mobiles/Normal/BaseCreature.cs, Scripts/Misc/RegenRates.cs, Scripts/Skills/Meditation.cs, Config/PlayerCaps.cfg

Regen.Model: Each pool gains 1 point every Interval seconds; the interval is recomputed after every tick.

Hits.HitPointRegen: Hit Point Regeneration item property + creature DefaultHitsRegen + 2 for human players; floored at 0; players capped at 18; then +20 Horrific Beast, + Ninjitsu Fixed/30 in dog/cat form, + mastery bonuses (after the cap)
Hits.Stops: dead, or poisoned (unless the creature regenerates through poison); summons and dead pets never regenerate hits

Interval.Note: Monster = a creature flagged as a monster

Stam.StamRegen: Stamina Regeneration item property + creature DefaultStamRegen + 15 Vampiric Embrace, +20 Kirin form; players capped at 24; then mastery bonuses; floored at -1
Stam.Note: Each tick also gives a Focus gain check. Paragons and dead pets do not regenerate stamina.

MedBonus.Note: The source also multiplies by 1.1 when MedBonus >= 100, which can never happen.

ItemBonus.Note: negative (between -0.2 and -0.135) when ManaRegen is 0, as in the source

Mana.ManaRegen: Mana Regeneration item property + creature DefaultManaRegen + 3 Vampiric Embrace or +13 Lich form + 2 for gargoyle players (no cap in ML)
Mana.Note: Each tick gives Meditation (when not actively meditating) and Focus gain checks. Dead pets do not regenerate mana.

Value.Note: Each worn armor piece adds: 0 if it has Mage Armor or Spell Channeling, otherwise its scaled base armor rating (MeditationAllowance None), half of it (Half) or 0 (All). Shields don't count in AOS.

ArmorPenalty.Effect: Any penalty above 0 removes MedBonus entirely and blocks active Meditation.

Meditation.Effect: Sets Meditating (doubles MedBonus) until the meditator acts, moves or is hurt.
Meditation.Hands: Weapons/shields other than spellbooks, runebooks and Spell Channeling items go to the backpack.

Mana.Note: SeriousFun: when basic reagents are free (below), a player casting from a book pays 1.25 x mana, rounded up, before Lower Mana Cost

ManaCost.LowerManaCost: the Lower Mana Cost item property, capped 40; InherentLMC = armor's inherent LMC (added after the cap)
ManaCost.Other: Mind Rot raises the scalar; Purge Magic's curse adds 0.5; a Mana Phasing Orb makes the next spell free. Wands cost no mana.
ManaCost.Checked: at cast start (to begin) and again when the spell takes effect (spent then)

Reagents.Rule: SeriousFun (Spells.FreeBasicReagents, default true): a player casting from a book does not consume the eight basic reagents (Black Pearl, Blood Moss, Garlic, Ginseng, Mandrake Root, Nightshade, Spiders' Silk, Sulfurous Ash) -- every Magery spell -- and pays the higher mana instead. Otherwise each listed reagent costs 1.
Reagents.Skip: Scrolls consume the scroll instead. Lower Reagent Cost (percent) skips the reagents entirely. Non-player casters never use reagents.
Reagents.ArcaneGemFallback: When reagents are missing, an Arcane Gem charge (1) pays instead.

CastDelay.Notes: Circle is 1-8. BaseDelta and Multiplier are per spell (Spells[].CastDelay). The 0.1 s subtraction happens after the minimum (EA timing). SeriousFun: Faster Casting is uncapped (stock caps Magery at 2). Protection (and Urali tonic) costs 2 Faster Casting. Pre-AOS: 0.5 + 0.25 x (Circle - 1) s, no FC.
CastDelay.Wand: the base delay, no Faster Casting

Recovery.Notes: Seconds after the spell takes effect before another can be started (1.5 s at 0 FCR). Faster Cast Recovery is not capped. Wands ignore it. Pre-AOS: 0.75 s.

Chance.Note: Below Min always fails, at/above Max always succeeds

SkillCheck.Window: Min/Max = 100/7 x (Circle - 1) -/+ 20 from a book; a scroll uses Circle - 2. Recall from a runebook needs no skill.
SkillCheck.Also: Evaluating Intelligence gets a gain check (0-cap) with every cast. Creature casters never fail the Magery check.

Fizzle.SkillCheckFailed: spell fizzles: the reagents are already used up (they are taken just before the skill check), the mana is kept (only spent on success)
Fizzle.Hurt: AOS: a player caster damaged while casting (or holding a target cursor) is disturbed unless under Protection, or a Casting Focus roll succeeds: chance% = min(12, CastingFocus property (+2 Fish Pie)) + (Inscribe >= 50 ? trunc(InscribeFixed / 200) : 0); 100%-element damage can also be shrugged off by matching Resonance (capped 40). Creature casters are never disturbed by damage. No recovery delay after a disturb.
Fizzle.Moving: A player cannot move while casting (frozen until the spell is cast); there is no fizzle from movement.
Fizzle.Equip: Equipping anything other than a spell-castable weapon while casting disturbs.
Fizzle.UseItem: Using an object while holding the spell's target disturbs it.
Fizzle.NewCast: Starting a new spell while the previous one waits for a target cancels the old one.
Fizzle.Paralyzed: Paralysed/frozen at the moment the spell resolves: fizzle.
Fizzle.Refused: Cannot start while: dead, calmed (Peacemaking), already casting, in an animal/Horrific Beast form, paralysed/frozen, still recovering, short of mana, flying over precarious ground, driving a boat.
Fizzle.Hands: SeriousFun (Spells.WeaponCasting, default true): weapons go to the backpack on cast, except staves stay for non-healing spells and maces/shields stay for healing/buff spells; Spell Channeling items always stay. Healing/buff spells: Heal, Cure, Greater Heal, Arch Cure, Resurrection, Bless, Strength, Agility, Cunning, Protection, Arch Protection, Reactive Armor, Night Sight, Magic Reflection.

Percent.Note: Circle 1-8; Target.MagicResist is lowered by Evil Omen

ResistedFormula.Roll: resisted if Percent >= 100, never if <= 0, otherwise if Percent / 100 >= randf()
ResistedFormula.Gain: the target gets a Resisting Spells gain check if its skill is below (Circle x 10) + (1 + trunc((Circle - 1) / 6)) x 25
ResistedFormula.UsedBy: AOS: only Poison (full negation). Pre-AOS most damage spells took x0.75 (Flame Strike x0.6, Mind Blast x0.5) and Paralyze x0.75 when resisted.

EvalIntScaling.SDI: Spell Damage Increase item property, -10 under a Runed Sash's ward, minus the target's Block reduction. Player vs player (caster and target both players): capped at 30 if the caster has no 30+ skill in another spell school (Spell Focus), else 20.
EvalIntScaling.Scalar: 1.0, x the creature's own damage adjustments, x the caster's spellbook slayer (3.0, or 2.0 for a super slayer) or x2.0 if the target's book/weapon is an opposing super slayer, x region adjustments; 0 if the target evades (Evasion). Area/chain spells use 1.0 here.
EvalIntScaling.Then: The result goes through the target's resistances by damage type (combat system).

Expr.Expr: trunc(trunc(trunc(trunc((rand(Dice, Dice * Sides) + Base) * 100 * EvalScale / 100) * (100 + DamageBonus) / 100) * trunc(Scalar * 100) / 100) / 100)
Expr.Note: the same as Steps, in one line; rand(Dice, Dice*Sides) stands for the dice roll

EvalIntScaling.PreAOS: base x (1 + (EvalInt - Resist)/500 if EvalInt > Resist, else /200) + (Magery - 100)/400; x2 vs non-human monsters.

HealScaling.Note: SeriousFun: player heal spells scale like damage (no PvP cap, no target scalar). Non-player casters use the spell's NonPlayerCaster formula.

Reflection.AOS: The Magic Reflection spell does not reflect in AOS. A spell marked Reflectable can still be sent back by: SeriousFun Spell Reflection gear (chance% = total of the target's worn items, capped 75), creatures with their own reflect ability, or a Mirror Image clone taking the hit.
Reflection.PreAOS: MagicDamageAbsorb points (8-15): each reflected spell costs Circle points.

DelayedDamage.Note: Damage lands Delay seconds after the spell takes effect (Explosion uses its own 3 s fuse).

Targeting.Harmful: a mobile (or damageable item for damage spells) the caster may harm; makes the caster an aggressor
Targeting.Beneficial: a mobile the caster may help
Targeting.Location: a ground point or object (its location), line of sight required
Targeting.Item: an item of the kind the spell names
Targeting.Self: no target; acts on the caster

Notes: SeriousFun also has ExtendedMagery (Scripts/Custom/ExtendedMagery.cs): extra Magery spells with server ids 1000+ and circles past the 8th. They are not part of this export.

Casting reveals a hidden caster. Order when the spell resolves (after the cast delay and any target pick): reagents are taken, mana is checked, the Magery check is rolled, and only on success is the mana spent and the scroll used up.
Vampiric Embrace: casting a spell that uses Garlic deals 17-23 fire damage to the caster.
Every harmful spell breaks Evil Omen and triggers the target's on-harmful reactions.

CreatureCasting.Source: Scripts/Mobiles/AI/Magical AI/MageAI.cs: the plain (non-SmartAI) path, magery only
CreatureCasting.CanCast: UO's CheckCanCastMagery with Core.SA: enough mana for the circle (CircleMana) is all; the Magery check at the end of the cast can still fizzle it

Dispel.Note: its target is a summoned creature: 75% at GM Magery (scaled by Magery), only with Int 95+

Heal.Note: not summoned; chance scaled by Magery; then Random(0, 4 + HitsMax / Hits) must be 3 or more; Greater Heal when 50+ hits down, Heal when 10+

Choices.Note: only if the target isn't poisoned, else damage
Bless (if not blessed, circle 3), else Invisibility (not a pet, circle 6), else damage
half the time Curse (if circle 5 is castable), else Weaken, Clumsy or Feeblemind
half the time Mana Vampire (circle 7), else Mana Drain (circle 4), else damage

Damage.Note: select = the highest castable of the ladder (else 1); the spell is Spells[Random(select)]

Book.Note: Content: what a new book holds, one bit per spell from Offset

Necromancy.Notes: Necromancy isn't sped by Faster Casting in the newest era (it is: CastDelayFastScalar 1 since SE); it uses reagents (pig iron, bat wing, grave dust, daemon blood, nox crystal); casting costs karma.

Book.Note: Content: what a new book holds, one bit per spell from Offset

Chivalry.Notes: Chivalry costs tithing points (gold given at an ankh) and mana, no reagents; its words are spoken by everyone; blows can't disturb it; recovery is 7 quarter seconds; spell power comes from karma and Chivalry (ComputePowerValue).

Book.Note: Content: what a new book holds, one bit per spell from Offset

Bushido.Notes: Bushido: stances (Confidence, Evasion, Counter Attack; one at a time) and moves readied for the next blow; the skill must reach the requirement, success runs from 12.5 below it to 37.5 above; casting isn't sped by faster casting; recovery is 7 quarter seconds.

Book.Note: Content: what a new book holds, one bit per spell from Offset

Ninjitsu.Notes: Ninjitsu: moves readied for the next blow (Backstab and Surprise Attack from stealth), Animal Form, Mirror Image and Shadowjump; casting doesn't reveal you; recovery is 7 quarter seconds.

Book.Note: Content: what a new book holds, one bit per spell from Offset

Spellweaving.Notes: Spellweaving: power grows with an arcane focus (Focus 0-6 in the formulas), made by Arcane Circle; success from 12.5 below the requirement to 37.5 above; resisted at (50 + 2 x (target's Magic Resist - caster's Spellweaving))%. The epic arcanist quest that unlocks it in UO isn't required (quests come later).

Book.Note: Content: what a new book holds, one bit per spell from Offset

Mysticism.Notes: Mysticism: eight circles like Magery (mana 4-50, cast time (4 + circle) quarter seconds); success from 100/7 x circle - 20 to + 20 (a scroll counts two circles lower); its damage skill is the better of Focus and Imbuing (Boost in the formulas); resisted like Magery by circle.

Kill.Note: the killer (a pet's or summon's master) gets the creature's fame / 100 and minus its karma / 100, then AwardFame/AwardKarma: a gain shrinks by the current value / 100 (a loss by the same), never past the limits

Ankh.Note: ankh halves (Items/Functional/Ankhs.cs: 0x2-0x5, bloodied 0x1D97, 0x1D98, 0x1E5C, 0x1E5D): stand by one to tithe gold from your bank
